name: Feature Cards Triptych
summary: A small set of cards, panels or icon tiles enter together and settle side by side or in an overlapping cascade, each standing for one feature, theme or benefit. It lets the viewer take in a few parallel ideas at once before the video unpacks them.
when_to_use: Previewing a few features or benefits that later scenes will explain
Showing variations of one thing, such as themes or page types
A summary beat that groups outcomes before a close

slots.name: cards
slots.what: a few cards, panels or icon tiles, each standing for one idea

slots.name: card_labels
slots.what: a short label or icon under or on each card

slots.name: layout
slots.what: a side-by-side row, an overlapping collage or a diagonal cascade

slots.name: background
slots.what: a solid or gradient stage that keeps the cards readable

slots.name: cue_words
slots.what: narration words that introduce each card

steps: The previous view pushes out or a single card shrinks to make room
The cards fly or slide in with a short stagger, often with blur clearing as they land
They settle into a row, collage or cascade, sometimes timed to the narration naming each one
The group holds with a slow drift or gentle rotation for depth
The cards collapse back together, push out or zoom through into the next scene

build.gsap: One timeline per scene. Exit the previous view with a y or x translate plus motion blur. Enter the cards from below or the side with a staggered tween of y, opacity and a blur filter clearing to sharp (power3.out). For a carousel of icon tiles, scale the new tile into the centre while the previous one shrinks and moves to a side slot (power2.inOut). Hold with a slow linear or sine drift per card at different speeds for parallax, then reverse the stagger or push the group out.
build.remotion: One Sequence for the entrance and hold and one for the exit. Offset each card's spring() by its index for the stagger, with damping high enough to avoid overshoot. Drive the slow drift with interpolate() over the full Sequence length at a different rate per card. Blur is interpolate() from a high value to zero on each card's own progress.

sound: No typical sound. Labels are mixed and often unsure; a soft impact or music hit may land as the cards settle, and chimes can mark each card in some videos.
caveats: No measured motion events or patterns, so none are listed; card wall stagger and parallax layers fit the descriptions.
Mixed members: overlapping web-page collages, rotating cubes, icon carousels and a plain screen recording are grouped together.
Few shots, and the chime cues come from a single video.
